description:
A well defined CSF intensity ovoid lesion at the right frontal lobe with extensive surrounding edema. The lesion shows faint peripheral enhancement, however, the dural coverings of the lobe show linear enhancement.

Significant mass effect with midline shifting and subfalcine herniation.
